📣 OPEN CALL | Climate in Translation 

We invite artists from Uzbekistan and Tajikistan to apply for Climate in Translation - an interdisciplinary laboratory exploring the intersections of art, data, and environmental futures.

Taking place in Tashkent from 23–28 November 2026, the lab will bring together artists, mentors, and researchers to creatively explore some of Central Asia’s most pressing environmental challenges: desertification, air quality, and water resources.

The lab welcomes artists from a range of disciplines, including visual arts, design, music and sound, photography, film, digital media, and performance. No previous experience in data visualization is required.

The resulting works will contribute to an interdisciplinary exhibition in spring 2027.

🗓 Application deadline: 08. November 2026
➡️ Application via Link in bio.

Organized by ARTepa Gallery by Green University, Goethe-Institut Usbekistan, and Art Station.
Supported by the Committee for Ecology and Climate Protection.
